title: Third, cut / 3도, 컷 (3 min)
description: The fundamental is E1, so the organ's G# is harmonic 5 — the pure major third. Sampler: the cicadas are stretched to ×0.3 in Glissando while only their pitch moves by 5/4 and 4/5 (pitch-only mode), with a tape copy sinking 5/8 → 1/2 under a tremolo that speeds up; the organ follows Draw arcs at ×1, ×5/4, ×3/2 and ×4/5 (the last one stretched); a 0.6 s loop cut from sf-3 phases against itself in Tempo, with a third voice 5:4 slower and a third lower; sf-1 circles in a Space Studio track on harmonics 8, 10 and 12, slow sound (×0.3) so circling becomes vibrato; sf-4 rides Field eddies up a third and down a sixth. Grid adds 5:4 copies of the cicada lines, stepped and glitched by thirds. Risset: four region modules with their own settings — octaves at half speed; 5:4 falling with a triangle tremolo, spinning; 6:5 rising on a ×1.5 clock, swinging; a thin 5:4 module on top falling fast with flutter. The Fractal track is gated by a beat-synced square tremolo (5 per 4 beats). Manager: a range leaves organ and cicadas alone (22–26 s), a lens around harmonics 8–10 empties four tracks (30–44 s), a lens around the high grains (12–20 s), a range without the ticks (46–50 s). Modulation: ticks duck the standing modes and retrigger the eddies, the organ's pitch moves the grains' centre, the cicadas' pitch brightens the Hénon glides. Space Master: HRTF, sound ×0.4. / 기음이 E1이라 오르간의 G#은 제5배음 — 순정 장3도. 샘플러: 매미는 글리산도에서 ×0.3으로 늘인 채 음고만 5/4·4/5로 이동(음높이만 모드), 오르간은 드로잉 호(×1·×5/4·×3/2·×4/5), sf-3에서 잘라낸 0.6초 루프는 템포에서 위상 어긋남(세 번째 성부는 5:4 느리고 3도 아래), sf-1은 스페이스 스튜디오에서 배음 8·10·12로 공전(느린 음속 → 비브라토), sf-4는 필드 소용돌이. 그리드는 매미 선의 5:4 복사본을 계단·글리치로. 리세: 영역 모듈 4개가 각자 설정. 매니저: 구간 솔로(22–26초), 배음 8–10 렌즈 영역(30–44초), 높은 그레인 렌즈(12–20초), 틱 없는 구간(46–50초). 스페이스 마스터: HRTF, 음속 ×0.4. THREE-MINUTE CUT VERSION. Material: 0–56 s the original; 56–112 s its retrograde (reversed takes of every track, on mirrored Space paths); 112–180 s the same tracks as tape takes at 2:3, 4:5, 5:4 and 3:2 (speed and pitch together, so the harmonic series is kept), with one track each from “Root” and “Fifth” as guests. Over it 162 range solos let one track through at a time (42 follow the strongest Doppler turn, 18 are silences); the other cuts take the largest contrast to the cut before, rotating level → timbre → pitch → place. The rule for the cut lengths changes nine times and the sections shrink (60, 40, 27, 18, 12, 8, 6, 5, 4 s): cuts centred on Doppler turns; accelerando 4 → 0.5 s; 3:2 lattice; Fibonacci groups; 0.75 s pulse with every fourth silent; 5:4 lattice; 0.3 s pulse; accelerando to 0.125 s; 0.25 s on / off. From the fifth section on the cuts cycle through fewer and fewer tracks, so the ear goes to the rhythm. At 18–28 s a band edge rises through two tracks, at 34–44 s a middle band closes between two others (shape regions with moving borders). / 3분 컷 버전. 소재: 0–56초 원본, 56–112초 역행(모든 트랙의 역행 테이크, 좌우 반전된 공간 경로), 112–180초 2:3·4:5·5:4·3:2 테이프 테이크 + 다른 두 프로젝트에서 온 게스트 트랙. 그 위에 구간 솔로 162개(도플러 42개, 무음 18개). 컷 길이 규칙이 아홉 번 바뀌고 구간은 60 → 4초로 줄어듦. 다섯째 구간부터는 점점 적은 수의 트랙을 순환해 리듬이 들리도록. 18–28초·34–44초는 경계가 움직이는 음역 띠.
